request: Turn the images of one work with a swipe gesture on mobile

behavior.applies_to: Multi-page works on the detail page; single-page works and ugoira video keep the existing view
behavior.track: Previous, current and next pages sit side by side in one frame, so the neighbour follows the finger
behavior.input: Touch and pen only; mouse keeps the buttons and arrow keys
behavior.turn_threshold: More than 20% of the frame width, or a flick of more than 30px faster than 0.35px/ms over the last 100ms
behavior.edge_resistance: 1/4 of the drag on the first and last page
behavior.second_finger: Cancels the swipe and leaves pinch zoom to the browser
behavior.pinch_zoomed_page: touch-action auto, so one finger pans the zoomed view
behavior.button_or_key_during_animation: The pending swipe is dropped, so the page moves once
behavior.pointer_capture: The image's implicit touch capture is handed to the track; the image's bubbling lostpointercapture does not end the swipe

verification_input: Chrome touch emulation in the in-app browser turned mouse input into touches; the page received trusted (isTrusted) touch pointer events that went through touch-action handling. Direct CDP touch dispatch and synthesized gestures are blocked in the in-app browser
limits: Not checked on a physical phone or iOS Safari
A two-finger pinch was not performed; the zoomed state was reproduced with page scale 2
Pages already open before the deployment need a refresh
